summary: Hydrography water exclusion feature for BIONIC zones tested successfully. All 5 backend API endpoints working correctly. Frontend 'Exclusion Eau' panel visible and functional with toggle ON/OFF, tolerance display (5m), and loading indicator.

design_issues.screen: Mon Territoire BIONIC - Exclusion Eau panel
issues: Loading indicator 'Analyse hydrographique...' may show for extended periods due to external WFS service latency (Quebec MRNF, Canada CanVec, USA NHD). This is expected behavior as these are real external government services.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend hydrography_service.py: Well-structured with proper caching, multi-source fallback system, and geometric calculations
Backend hydrography_router.py: Clean API design with proper Pydantic models and error handling
Frontend useWaterExclusion.js: Proper React hook with caching, debouncing, and error handling
Frontend MonTerritoireBionicPage.jsx: Water exclusion panel properly integrated at lines 1516-1557
seed_data_creation: None - Used real hydrographic data from external services
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hydrography water exclusion feature fully implemented and tested. Backend uses 4 official hydrographic sources (Quebec MRNF, Canada CanVec, USA NHD, OSM fallback) with automatic region detection. Frontend panel shows in right sidebar on /mon-territoire-bionic page.

api_hydro_sources.description: Returns list of 4 hydrographic sources with coverage info

api_hydro_sources_detect.description: Detects available sources for a location (Quebec returns 4 sources)

api_hydro_water_features.description: Returns water polygons from OSM/official sources (17 features found for Quebec City)

api_hydro_check_point.description: Checks if a point is in water with tolerance (5m default)

api_hydro_filter_zones.description: Filters BIONIC zones to exclude those in water

frontend_exclusion_eau_panel.description: Panel visible in right sidebar with cyan styling

frontend_map_integration.description: 55 interactive BIONIC zones displayed on map
